scope: Sanitized legacy-server parity: client compatibility, corrected emulator defects (project planning)

domains.title: Transport, authentication and startup
domains.implemented: Packet, cipher, startup and replacement-service paths exist. Account and mailbox mode parsers validate coherent physical envelopes; hostile mailbox counts reject before item allocation. Malformed saved-credential admission is removed; secure native handoff is still unproved. An earlier build demonstrated limited local gameplay.
domains.remaining: Prove the authenticated native account-to-world handoff and protected D13 login payload; complete ownership and loader joins, then verify the published build and staged endpoint migration with the actual client.

domains.title: Shared player, items and persistence
domains.implemented: Bag/warehouse moves validate PIN, capacity and escrow before persisted success. Ordinary mailbox claims use recoverable files; D13 text fields follow the client. Explicit allocating package owners now join durable UID intent, four-file work/recovery, guarded read-only startup, PIN and delivery checks with focused proof. Production Host activation, native Inventory/wallet/save adoption and full package fidelity remain unfinished.
domains.remaining: Prove client warehouse cache/resynchronization behavior after committed-but-undelivered mutations. Finish one shared native player/item graph, login-loader, real login/save worker, production callers, legacy SQL/provider compatibility and restart recovery.

domains.title: Combat, monsters and death
domains.implemented: Substantial spell, damage, receive, equipment, monster AI, rewards and death behavior has focused automated proof. Physical monster admission validates actual minimum-damage, Rune, Gear and conditional Ninja owners before output/RNG; the full-adjustment sentinel returns its intended maximum. Equipped sigils use owned snapshots and reject missing selected metadata before damage or cooldown spending.
domains.remaining: Complete all callers, native arithmetic and shared RNG/order semantics, drops, lifetime ownership and multi-player/client scenarios.

domains.title: NPCs, shops, progression and housing
domains.implemented: Main dispatch, shops, forging, skill learning and durable progression/reward paths exist. Native quest definitions, eligibility, dialog and experience tables have component proof. House load/save validate complete files/graphs before publication; authenticated housing adoption, entry and furniture economy remain unfinished.
domains.remaining: Close deferred mutations and exact economy/persistence ordering; complete housing, occupants and furniture lifecycle.

domains.title: Trade, social systems and events
domains.implemented: Managed Trade and player-booth exchanges use ordered pair commits and a shared journal. Tests cover complete closures, stale-file/escrow refusal, failure/retry, refunds/disconnect/restart and D13 Frame settlement. Warehouse composition preserves real 300-silver escrow: changed offered roots refund; unrelated withdrawals allow exchange. Guild/clan projections, selected actions, timers, score panels and some event state machines exist.
domains.remaining: Complete native/social/event ownership and real-client multiplayer acceptance. Broader inventory/storage and booth raw-writer/delivery lifecycles, remaining guild/union actions, brackets, rewards, claims, reset, database parity and durable recovery remain open; scoped managed tests do not certify all transfers.

domains.title: Cross-server and casino workflows
domains.implemented: Group/travel metadata, startup packets, poker data and visibility surfaces exist.
domains.remaining: Complete genuine transfer/return/session/economy ownership and failure handling; verify table rounds, betting, pot and settlement.
